listeningQuestions.audio: A good speaker keeps the audience interested from start to finish.
opts: 好的演讲者能让听众从头到尾都感兴趣。
好的演讲者总是说得很快。
好的演讲者从不看观众。

listeningQuestions.audio: Practising aloud again and again helps you sound natural on stage.
opts: 反复大声练习能让你在台上显得自然。
上台前不要做任何准备。

listeningQuestions.audio: If you feel nervous inside, you can still look confident on stage.
opts: 即使内心紧张,你仍能在台上显得自信。

listeningQuestions.audio: Braille lets blind people read and write by touching raised dots.
opts: 盲文让盲人通过触摸凸点来读写。

listeningQuestions.audio: A sincere respect for differences helps us cross the cultural barrier.
opts: 真诚尊重差异有助于我们跨越文化障碍。
说得更大声能解决文化障碍。
文化障碍是无法克服的。

listeningQuestions.audio: A good summary catches the main point and leaves out small examples.
opts: 好的摘要抓住主旨、略去小例子。
好的摘要要照抄原文长句。

quizQuestions.q: 选出与 deliver a speech 意思最接近的表达。
be passionate about sth 最贴切的意思是?
reach a compromise 的意思是?
The lecturer ____ overcame his fear later became famous.
____ you keep practising, you will gradually beat stage fright.
____ matters most in a great speech is a genuine connection with people.
The fact ____ a deaf-blind girl could learn to read amazed the world.

opts: 走动和提问有助于吸引听众参与。
quizQuestions.audio: Movement and questions help engage the listeners.

opts: 眼神交流让听众觉得你在和他们说话。
演讲时应避免目光接触。
quizQuestions.audio: Eye contact makes listeners feel you are talking to them.

reading.passage: When Mia stepped onto the stage, her hands were shaking. She found one friendly face in the crowd, took a slow breath, and began to speak to that single person. Little by little, the whole room felt smaller, and her fear melted away.
reading.passageCn: 米娅走上舞台时双手发抖。她在人群中找到一张友善的脸,缓缓吸了口气,然后对着那一个人开始讲。渐渐地,整个房间似乎变小了,她的恐惧也消散了。

questions.q: What did Mia do to calm herself?
opts: She spoke to one friendly face and breathed slowly
She closed her eyes and shouted
She read quickly from a script

questions.q: What happened to Mia's fear by the end?

writing.prompt: Write a short summary (about 50 words) of a talk on how to keep an audience engaged.
writing.promptCn: 用约50词写一篇关于“如何让听众保持专注”的演讲摘要:先用一句话概括总观点,再提炼三到四条建议,用自己的话表达。

lines.text: The contest is on Friday and I'm terrified.
Practise out loud until the words feel natural.
lines.cn: 大声练习,直到说得自然。

lines.text: I always rush when I'm nervous.
Breathe slowly first, then speak to one friendly face.
lines.cn: 先慢慢呼吸,再对着一张友善的脸说。

lines.text: Your opening question made us all curious.
lines.cn: 你开场的提问让我们都很好奇。

lines.text: Thanks. But I read too much from my notes.
lines.cn: 谢谢,但我太多照稿念了。

lines.text: Next time, use a card with only key words.
lines.cn: 下次用只写关键词的卡片。

lines.text: And look up at the audience more. I'll try.
lines.cn: 还要多抬头看观众。我会试试。
